scheme.name: Romania's Danube bridge tolls (tarif de trecere)

dataset.method: Legea nr. 226/2023 privind aplicarea unor tarife rutiere pe rețeaua de drumuri naționale din România, art. 24 (1): Ordonanța Guvernului nr. 15/2002, which set the tolls on the Danube bridges at Fetești–Cernavodă and Giurgeni–Vadu Oii, is repealed from 1 October 2026, and (3) the tolls issued under it lapse. Trucks over 3.5 t pay TollRo per km instead (Romania's table).

sources.title: Legea nr. 226/2023 (CNAIR eToll, acte normative), art. 24

coverage.reason: crossings is kept as an extension (no ORCT field yet)

no_charge.description: no toll on the Danube bridges at Fetești–Cernavodă and Giurgeni–Vadu Oii (Legea nr. 226/2023, art. 24: OG 15/2002, which set it, is repealed from 1 October 2026); trucks pay TollRo per km instead.
